categories.name: Hardware & Fasteners
categories.summary: Nuts, bolts, screws, washers and industrial hardware — plus in-house custom metal fabrication.
categories.long: The division we started with. A deep inventory of nuts, bolts, screws, washers and fasteners across grades and sizes, backed by in-house CNC machining, laser cutting and finishing for custom metal parts.

categories.name: Spices & Masale
categories.summary: Whole & ground, single spices and blends — haldi, lal mirch, Kashmiri lal mirch, garam masala, jeera and many more.
categories.long: If it is a spice, we stock it. Whole khade masale and freshly ground powders — haldi, lal mirch, Kashmiri lal mirch, jeera, dhaniya, kali mirch, laung, elaichi, hing and more — plus garam masala, chaat masala, chicken and South Indian blends. Graded for colour and aroma, supplied loose or packed to any size.

categories.name: Dry Fruits & Nuts
categories.summary: Almonds, cashews, raisins, pistachios and all dry fruits — premium grades, bulk or loose.
categories.long: Premium dry fruits and nuts in multiple grades — almonds, cashews, raisins, pistachios, walnuts and more. Hand-checked for quality and supplied loose or in sealed bulk and gift packs.

categories.name: Polybags & Packaging
categories.summary: Poly bags in every size and gauge — plain or printed, food-grade — loose or in bulk.
categories.long: Poly bags for every need — from small grocery bags to large heavy-gauge bags, plain or printed to your design. Food-grade options for spices and dry fruits. Bought loose or in bulk.

seo.title: About Us | Swastik Enterprises
seo.description: From a 2015 hardware counter to a four-division wholesale house — hardware, spices, dry fruits and packaging, supplied loose or in bulk.

header.title: From one counter to *four divisions*.
header.subtitle: A hands-on family business that grew by saying yes to what our customers needed next.

about.imageAlt: Sacks of stock in the store room
story: Swastik Enterprises started in 2015 as a single hardware counter selling fasteners to local fabricators. The promise was simple: the right item, in stock, at a fair price.

As our customers' needs grew, so did we. Restaurants asked for spices, sweet shops for dry fruits, packers for polybags — and instead of sending them elsewhere, we built each into a proper division. Today four aisles run under one roof and one trusted relationship.
We're still, at heart, the supplier that picks up the phone, quotes honestly and delivers on time — whether you need a carton of bolts, a sack of jeera or a truckload of almonds.

faqHead.label: Questions
faqHead.title: Good to *know*.
faqHead.body: Still unsure? Call or WhatsApp — a real person answers.

faq.q: Can I buy loose quantities, or only bulk?
faq.a: Both. Buy loose by the kilo or pre-packed in retail and bulk poly packs — a single carton or a full truckload.

faq.q: How quickly will I get a quote?
faq.a: Send your list and we'll come back with rates and lead time within one working day — usually the same day.

faq.q: Can you print polybags with our brand?
faq.a: Yes. Poly bags come plain or printed to your design, in every size and gauge, with food-grade options for spices and dry fruits.

faq.q: Do you make custom hardware parts?
faq.a: Yes. Our in-house CNC machining, laser cutting and finishing produce custom metal parts to your drawing.
Orders are packed and shipped across India, with documents and certificates where you need them.
